subject: english
question: Choose the sentence that contains correct spellings.

options.text: Esha risembles her mother very much.
Esha resimbles her mother very much.
Esha resembles her mother very much.
Esha risimbles her mother very much.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"resemble"** means to look or seem like someone or something. (समान दिखना)

 
 
• **Example:** The twins resemble each other so closely that it's hard to tell them apart.
 
 
 
• **"Resembles"** is the correct spelling and it means to have a similar appearance to someone or something. (समानता होना)

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Esha risembles her mother very much.**: This is an incorrect spelling of the word "resembles".
 
• **​Option 2: Esha resimbles her mother very much.**: This is an incorrect spelling of the word "resembles".
 
• **​Option 4: Esha risimbles her mother very much.**: This is an incorrect spelling of the word "resembles".
